parties: <cite index="2-2">BookMyShow (BigTree Entertainment Private Limited), one of India's leading entertainment destinations, and KKR, a leading global investment firm</cite>
headline: <cite index="2-2">KKR and BookMyShow announced the signing of definitive agreements under which funds managed by KKR will acquire a minority stake</cite>
sum: KKR acquires minority stake in BookMyShow pursuant to definitive agreements signed 19 August 2026. The investment will support BookMyShow's next phase of growth as it scales its live entertainment business and deepens its full-stack offering across India.
implication: PE investment in ticketing/live entertainment requires CCI clearance where platform is found dominant; post-March 2026 CCI dominance finding creates regulatory gating item for this transaction and precedent for future entertainment platform consolidation.
detail: <cite index="1-3">KKR will make the investment through funds it manages, under definitive agreements signed on Wednesday (August 19)</cite>. <cite index="1-4">Financial terms of the KKR investment were not disclosed, and the transaction is subject to regulatory approvals</cite>. <cite index="1-5,1-6">Founded in 2007, BookMyShow is owned and operated by Bigtree Entertainment Pvt. Ltd. and operates across more than 700 towns and cities in India</cite>. <cite index="6-3">The deal is expected to close subject to customary regulatory approvals and conditions</cite>.

framework.note: CCI combination approval required; BookMyShow found dominant in online movie ticketing (March 2026); minority PE stake likely triggers § 5 combination notification threshold.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (§ 6, Schedule I)
framework.note: FEMA approval for inbound foreign investment from KKR funds (US-domiciled PE vehicle).
Board approval for issuance of shares to KKR (minority equity stake); shareholder approval if >25% threshold breached.
Tax treatment of investment by foreign fund; withholding on dividend/capital gains.

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) Regulations, 2008 (Investment by FIIs)
framework.note: KKR fund may be registered FII; compliance with FII investment limits and reporting.
BookMyShow Live operates live entertainment; licensing for concert/event promotion may be affected by PE change of control.
BookMyShow operates rights in live entertainment IP; licensing continuity post-transaction.

structure.consideration: Undisclosed minority equity stake; no purchase price disclosed
conditions: <cite index="17-1">Approval required from the Competition Commission of India (CCI) prior to closing of the transaction</cite>
structure.novel: PE minority stake structured as investor entry into platform business earlier found dominant by CCI (March 2026); unique gating event combining antitrust and FDI clearance.

triggers.note: Combination notification required; BookMyShow designated dominant in online movie ticketing by CCI order (March 2026)
Inbound PE investment by non-resident KKR fund requires RBI/FEMA clearance
Board approval for minority share issuance; material related-party transactions if any existing KKR portfolio overlap
